full_citation: Eckerman K., Endo A. (2008). ICRP Publication 107: Nuclear Decay Data for Dosimetric Calculations. Annals of the ICRP 38(3). International Commission on Radiological Protection.
notes: Primary source for all half-lives, branching and emission energies. Article text is paywalled (SAGE) but the electronic database is free to download. Data-file copyright notice permits use for educational, research and not-for-profit purposes only; confirm the project falls within it.

full_citation: Endo A., Eckerman K.F. (2008; file rebuilt 22 Nov 2021 with corrected atomic masses). ICRP-07.NDX index file, ICRP-07 data files for ICRP Publication 107. ICRP.
notes: Downloaded directly from icrp.org (zip contains only the .NDX file). Gives half-life, decay mode, up to four daughters with branching, and summed alpha/electron/photon energies per decay. Parsed independently and found identical to S9003's NDX for all 103 nuclides used.

full_citation: Hogue M. (2024). RadData: Nuclear Decay Data for Dosimetric Calculations - ICRP 107. R package version 1.0.2 (CRAN), tidy conversion of ICRP-07.NDX/.RAD/.BET by K.F. Eckerman and A. Endo.
notes: Used ONLY as the machine-readable route to ICRP-07.RAD (emission energies and yields by radiation type incl. alpha recoil 'AR'), which could not be downloaded from icrp.org. Values are ICRP's; the package is a redistribution. Validated against S9002: alpha+recoil sums within 0.1%, electron and photon sums within rounding of the NDX columns. Data licence as S9001 (GPL-2 applies to package code).

full_citation: Malins A., Lemoine T., Cullen I. and contributors (2025). radioactivedecay: a Python package for radioactive decay modelling, version 0.6.1 (ICRP-107 half-lives and branching with AME2020/NUBASE2020 masses). PyPI release of 2025-01-09; GitHub radioactivedecay/radioactivedecay.
notes: Cross-check of half-lives only (agree with S9002 to 2e-5 for all 103 nuclides; the residual is the year definition). It carries no emission energies. Not independent of ICRP-107.

full_citation: IAEA Nuclear Data Section (accessed 2026-10-20). Live Chart of Nuclides data API v1 (ground_states, levels, decay_rads; ENSDF / NUBASE2020 based).
notes: Independent second source for the 10-value spot-check and the full 103-nuclide cross-check. ENSDF evaluation cut-off dates vary per nuclide (given per record in the API output). Mean energies computed here as sum(E x I) over the API's radiation lines; API year length is 365.2422 d, so half-lives were compared in source units.

full_citation: Laboratoire National Henri Becquerel (LNHB). Decay Data Evaluation Project (DDEP) recommended data tables: Cs-137_tables.pdf (S. Leblond, LNE-LNHB, 02/12/2021 - 18/07/2023; cite Mougeot et al., Metrologia 62 (2025) 029002) and I-129_tables.pdf (V.P. Chechev and V.O. Sergeev, 10/12/2001 - 18/6/2004), accessed 2026-10-20.
notes: Third source for Cs-137 (half-life 30.018(22) a; beta branching to Ba-137m 94.57(26)%) and I-129 (half-life 16.1(7)e6 a; mean beta energy 37(1) keV for the 99.5% branch).
